title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2022 · Fmge Mini Test 14

questions.stem: A 13-year-old boy presents with injury to the medial epicondyle of the humerus. Which of the following is least likely to be seen?
questions.stemHtml: A 13-year-old boy presents with injury to the medial epicondyle of the humerus. Which of the following is least likely to be seen?

options.label: A
options.text: Weakness of the ulnar deviation and flexion

options.label: B
options.text: Complete paralysis of the IIIrd and IVth digits

options.label: D
options.text: Decreased sensation of the hypothenar eminence
